notes.title: Version 1.06.3
notes.notes:
Hey,

It's hard to keep up with posting everywhere, a better but still not full log is available on the site and in-game menu.

1.06.1:

Added !fastmode 1 - 3 (!fastmodeup,!fast1,!fast2,!fast3,etc)
Mega Skelly HP Buffed and Gems Increased
Streamer Coins added (Gift All Players splits between all, left-click on the coins button is 100k and right click is 1 million) 10 Streamer Coins = 1 Gold

Extra Streamer Coins functions to come.



1.06.2:

Streamer Coins now a 1:1 Ratio to Gold.
Map Names shown in vote !map1 or !map2

1.06.3:

Fixed !fullsave not working as intended.

Thanks for the feedback,
Make sure to join the Discord or use !support in-game to help us squash any encountered bugs!

Ayrton

notes.title: Full Release
notes.notes:
I have finally managed full release!

More updates shall be coming but this is the state I planned to release the game in. (Plus some additions that made it in earlier than they should have!)

Still really appreciate feedback and am very looking forward to receiving some more suggestions!

See you on the stage!

notes.title: Update 0.95 - Global Saving introduced!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Global Saving is now here![/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45080388/a380feaf2d517b6252097ce0d6a092634e3f8d38.png[/img]

Testing out users keeping their levels from stream to stream, [b]highly recommended not to play simultaneously in 2 different streams[/b].

You can toggle this in the main settings by switching Global Save to Local Save, plus vice versa.

Always appreciating feedback, especially in these early days!
Thanks again,
Ayrton
